paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to complain about a neighbourhood walking event, which I attended at the park entrance. Unfortunately, the service did not meet the expectations set out in the information provided before I booked.

paragraphs.template:
Dear [danh xưng và họ người nhận],

I am writing to complain about [sự kiện / hoạt động], which I attended at [địa điểm]. Unfortunately, the service did not meet the expectations set out in the information provided before I booked.

paragraphs.text: The first problem was that there was almost no time for the advertised practical activity. In addition, the session started forty minutes late without an explanation. Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to complain about a family travel planning session, which I attended at the community centre. Unfortunately, the service did not meet the expectations set out in the information provided before I booked.
